title: A nested GROUPBY aggregates a column computed by the inner one
query: GROUPBY ( Sales, Product[Category], Product[Product], "Amt", SUMX ( CURRENTGROUP (), Sales[Amount] ) ),

source.quote: You have to use a new function, CURRENTGROUP , which enables the access to the internal group, so you have the table argument for an aggX function
source.supports: the article shows this nested pattern: an inner GROUPBY computing a column and an outer MAXX over CURRENTGROUP

derivation: Inner groups: Vehicles Bike 100 + 200 + 100 = 400; Accessories Helmet 40 + 20 = 60; Accessories Lock 50 + 30 = 80. Outer maximum per category: Vehicles 400, Accessories 80.
